jmapcDoc: SendEmail writes a message, hands it to the submission server, and files it under Sent once the send succeeds — all in one request, so the draft can never be left behind in Drafts by a call that failed halfway.

methodCalls.jmapcComment: Create the message. The creation id "draft" names it for the rest of the request, before the server has assigned it a real one.

Submit it for delivery, referring to the email by its creation id. On success, move it out of Drafts and into Sent and drop the $draft keyword, which the submission server does as part of the same call.
